name: the leftmost forwarded entry is trusted, so a client names its own address
the cap counts but never refuses
one visitor's runs are counted against everybody
yesterday's counts are kept, so nobody gets a new day
a laptop with no proxy in front of it is capped like a stranger
a misconfigured limit of zero refuses everybody instead of nobody
the cap is applied after the prompt is parsed, so bad prompts are free
the refusal says no and offers nothing to do about it
old:
remedy: Some(
                        concat!(
                            "Each analysis reads live pages and runs a model for several ",
                            "minutes, so the free limit is per day. Come back tomorrow, or ",
                            "run your own copy - it is open source."
                        )
                        .to_owned(),
                    ),
